notes.content: [h2]We will be holding our first ever pop-up store at Saihate Station![/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]We also have a wide variety of merchandise featuring new illustrations and in-game illustrations![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Online reservations: until August 31, 2025[/b][/h3][p][url="https://www.manga10.com/event/product/3442"]https://www.manga10.com/event/product/3442[/url][/p][p]Shipping will begin after October.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/94ac7f8ef898d26cf416a4a988afeaf0764e1f07.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h2]Event Dates: August 15 (Fri) – August 31 (Sun), 2025[/h2][p] [b]Location: Mangaten Shibuya[/b] [/p][p]Stock is limited, so if you see something you want, act fast![/p][p][b]There will also be merchandise autographed by me (which is nice, but embarrassing).[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/3cfc48a68e8932950b03b1ea324a8e70f71cfc0a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/b90410cf578e6fee9778b4035462d3ab6a53bbd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/4cb5917cbc5b103eb66659cae94d8cb6ac687ffe.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Experiencing load/play errors with old 'Saihate Station' saves post-update?
notes.content: [p]For those who are experiencing errors when loading old save data or during gameplay due to the update of the "Saihate Station" main game.[/p][p]Please launch the game using the old version (2.1.9) of Saihate Station.[/p][p][/p][p]\[How to Launch][/p][p]1. Right-click in the Library and select "Properties."[/p][p]2. Enter "oldstation1212" in the Beta tab and click "Verify Code."[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/8cc48e434087baef31337b4571780daafbc4a4a4.png"][/img][/p][p]3. Launch the game while it displays "Saihate Station \[old_game]."If you want to play [/p][p]Version 2.2.0, please select [b]"New Game[/b]"[/p]

notes.title: Saihate Station is released today!
notes.content:
The localized version of Saihate Station has finally been released!

A huge thank you to all the translators and volunteer translators!

The credits are listed on the website.

[b]Enjoy!

[/b]

[b][h1]Release Commemoration Event[/h1]

[/b]

[b][h2]Bromide sales start at Lawson Print and Ministop Print[/h2]

[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/d6b5f96abad3f00ef8eff3959556043ad0d0644d.jpg[/img]Bromide can be printed at Lawson and Ministop multi-copy machines (excluding some stores).
There are 11 designs in total, including original illustrations of everyday life that can't be seen in the game.
There are also Lawson Print and Ministop Print exclusive designs.
The first wave (7 types in total) will continue to be available for purchase. (Japan only)

Sales start: Friday, March 7, 2025, 0:00~

[b][h2]Limited goods available for pre-order in collaboration with indie game label "WorldMap"
[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/fca79f4abdfc3dd49a64fad2845fef64d54b9509.jpg[/img]

In collaboration with the indie game label "WorldMap" (operated by Try System Co., Ltd.), which has strengths in IP development, limited goods such as various original goods and apparel will be sold on a completely made-to-order basis.

Store page: https://worldmap-store.myshopify.com/collections/Saihate-eki
Order sales start date: Friday, March 7, 2025 - Friday, April 11, 2025

[b][h2]Exhibiting at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025
[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/fcfbfe72edef0ed9164640327f3f1fd890e05126.png[/img]
We will be participating in the indie game festival "TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT" to be held in Kichijoji on March 8th and 9th.

You will be playing the main game of SaihateStation playing DLC, and selling various goods.

I think this will be the last time we will exhibit at a game event at SaihateStation.

For more information, click here
https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/

[b]
[h2]Electronic setting materials collection (PDF) also available(Japanese only)
[/h2][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331460/_/?l=japanese

notes.title: 「さいはて駅 Demo」はリリースされました！
notes.content:
2.18でさいはて駅はリリース９ヶ月目を迎えます！
これを記念して、さいはて駅のデモをリリースいたしました。
９言語サポートした状態で、最初の車両からの脱出までを体験できます。
ぜひ一足先に、奇妙な駅での愛憎物語をお楽しみください！

（セーブデータの引き継ぎはできませんのでご了承ください。）

notes.title: Saihate Station Demo will be released on February 18th!
notes.content:
[b]Saihate Station will celebrate its 9th month loanch on the 2.18th. 
[/b]
[h3][b]To commemorate this, the Saihate Station Demo will be released on February 18th! 
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/f8a9e5a0e512b96116cf415e4406381c10c70687.png[/img]
[img][/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185393/641cd0c775cec0f9cb76eb0de2b8fdbb9b7c4a36.png[/img]

In the demo version, you can enjoy the game in 9 languages ​​until the first vehicle escapes. 
*Please note that this demo contains depictions of murder and gore.


i'm planning to participate in SteamNextFes.
It will be released soon. Let's enjoy the love-hate story that unfolds at a strange station!


------------------

[b]さいはて駅は２/１８日でローンチ９ヶ月を迎えます。
[h3]これを記念して、さいはて駅のDemoは2/18に公開されます！[/b]
[/h3]

Demo版では最初の車両の脱出まで、９言語でお楽しみいたけます。
本Demoは殺人、流血表現が含まれていますのでご注意ください。
SteamNextFesに参加予定です。
リリースまで後少しです。奇妙な駅で繰り広げられる愛憎物語を、一緒に楽しみましょう！

notes.title: βテストプレイヤーを募集！/ I'm looking for beta test players
notes.content:
[h2]Steam版さいはて駅［Version 2.1.6 ］βテストプレイヤー募集してます！[/h2]

[b]【定員】[/b]
各言語3名程度
もし応募が多ければ抽選になりますのでご了承ください。

[b]【対象者】[/b]
・さいはて駅の動作が保証されているPC（win or mac）をお持ちの方
・Steamアカウントを持っている方
・Googleスプレッドシートの操作が可能な方
・Googleのスライドが閲覧可能な方
・締切までにチェックが可能な方

[b]【特典】[/b]
・8言語遊べます
・デバッグ機能を搭載しています
・イラスト追加、変更箇所を一足先に見れます
・ボツ部屋とか本来なら探索できない場所にも行けます
・エンドクレジットとホームページにテスターとしてお名前を掲載します

[b]【応募方法】[/b]
Googleフォームにてメールアドレスなどの必要情報の記入をお願いいたします。

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe80AyHSEloZWpqYtPR3Hc7p7cWvUY96pwe6komdM9tiq7wPg/viewform?usp=preview


[b]【応募締め切り】[/b]
2月2日（日）〜23:59（GMT +9）

[b]【テスト期間】[/b]
〜2月16日（日） 



[h2]I'm looking for beta test players for the Steam version of Saihate Station [Version 2.1.6]!
[/h2]

[b][Capacity][/b]
About 3 people per language
If there are many applicants, please note that we will hold a lottery.

[b][Target][/b]
-People who have a PC (win or mac) that is guaranteed to run Saihate Station
-People who have a Steam account
-People who can operate Google Spreadsheets
-People who can view Google Slides
-People who can check by the deadline

[b][Benefits][/b]
-Playable in 8 languages
-Includes debugging function
-See added illustrations and changes before anyone else
-Go to rejected rooms and other places that you normally can't explore
-Your name will be listed in the end credits and on the homepage as a tester

[b][How to apply][/b]
Please fill in the necessary information such as your email address in the Google form.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe80AyHSEloZWpqYtPR3Hc7p7cWvUY96pwe6komdM9tiq7wPg/viewform?usp=preview
[b]
[Application Deadline][/b]
February 2 (Sun) - 23:59 (GMT +9)

[b][Test Play Deadline][/b]
February 16 (Sun) - 23:59 (GMT +9)
